rationale.conceptual: Established DFT methods applied to a surface reaction, but requires careful setup of pseudopotentials, k-points, supercell sizes, constrained optimization pathways, and identification of transition states; this is a non-trivial, multi-component implementation of documented algorithms.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has 5 sequential stages, each depending on prior results, requiring running DFT jobs, parsing outputs, computing energy differences, and integrating forces; it uses a standard DFT code (Quantum ESPRESSO) but the orchestration of many constrained relaxations and analysis is multi-step.
